notes: Inert unless KAGENT_PIG_POLICY names a policy file; with a policy it registers the MCP servers, holds the approval gate and offers ask_user, and an unusable policy stops PiG from starting.
The extension is Go and fuses into the Piglet Binary; it is built against PiG v0.7.0 and uses no dependency beyond the PiG SDK.
The manifest lists linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 for the kagent harness image; only linux/amd64 has been built and run, linux/arm64 is not a support claim.
Verified only against a hermetic mock model and a local MCP server; no real model provider was used.
